title: Calorize — service overview
description: RED metrics, latency, errors, client telemetry, logs and traces for calorize-api.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Can Prometheus scrape calorize-api /metrics? Drives the CalorizeDown alert.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Requests per second across the selected routes.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests that failed with a 5xx over the whole time range. Alert CalorizeHighErrorRate fires above 1% for 5m.

panels.title: 4xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests rejected with a 4xx over the time range (bad input, 401s, 404s). A jump usually means a client or auth regression, not a server fault.

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile request latency, excluding health probes. Alert CalorizeHighLatency fires above 1s for 5m.

panels.title: DB errors
panels.description: Database errors (WriteError + readiness ping) over the time range. Any non-zero value fires CalorizeDatabaseErrors.

panels.title: Client errors
panels.description: Browser errors reported to POST /api/v1/client-events over the time range (from Loki).

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the API process last started. Resets on every deploy or crash.

panels.title: Requests by status class
panels.description: Stacked request rate split by HTTP status class. The red band is server errors.

panels.title: Busiest routes
panels.description: Request rate for the 8 busiest routes in each interval.

panels.title: Route scorecard
panels.description: Every route over the selected time range: volume, error ratios and latency. Sorted by traffic; error and latency cells are coloured against the alert thresholds.

targets.expr: (sum by (route) (increase({__name__="calorize_http_requests_total", job="$job", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (route) (increase(calorize_http_requests_total{job="$job", route=~"$route"}[$__range])))) / clamp_min(sum by (route) (increase(calorize_http_requests_total{job="$job", route=~"$route"}[$__range])), 1)

(sum by (route) (increase({__name__="calorize_http_requests_total", job="$job", route=~"$route", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or (0 * sum by (route) (increase(calorize_http_requests_total{job="$job", route=~"$route"}[$__range])))) / clamp_min(sum by (route) (increase(calorize_http_requests_total{job="$job", route=~"$route"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 across selected routes, health probes excluded. Dashed line: the 1s CalorizeHighLatency threshold.

panels.title: Latency distribution
panels.description: Every request bucketed by duration over time. Bands creeping upward mean the whole service is slowing, not just the tail.

panels.title: Slowest routes (p95)
panels.description: p95 latency of the 8 slowest routes, health probes excluded.

targets.expr: topk(8, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (rate(calorize_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$job", route=~"$route", route!~".*/(healthz|readyz)"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: Slow or failed traces
panels.description: Recent calorize-api traces that took over 500ms or ended in an error (5xx). Click a trace ID to open the waterfall; logs for the trace are one more click away.

panels.title: 5xx error ratio
panels.description: Share of requests failing with a 5xx. Dashed line: the 1% CalorizeHighErrorRate threshold.

panels.title: 5xx by route
panels.description: Server errors per second, split by route and status code.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status) (rate({__name__="calorize_http_requests_total", job="$job", route=~"$route", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: 4xx by route
panels.description: Client errors per second, split by route and status. 401 = auth, 404 = missing resource, 429 = rate limited.

targets.expr: sum by (route, status) (rate({__name__="calorize_http_requests_total", job="$job", route=~"$route", status=~"4.."}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Database errors by kind
panels.description: Database errors per interval. kind=ping is the /readyz probe failing to reach SQLite.

panels.title: Expired sessions cleaned per hour
panels.description: Sessions removed by the background cleanup daemon. A flat zero for days can mean the daemon stopped.

panels.title: Response bandwidth by route
panels.description: Bytes served per second for the 8 heaviest routes.

panels.title: Client error reports
panels.description: Browser error batches accepted vs. dropped (rate limit, oversized payload or batch). Drops above 1/s fire CalorizeClientEventFlood.

panels.title: Client errors by kind
panels.description: Individual browser errors (from Loki), split by the kind the page reported.

panels.title: Top client error sources
panels.description: The most frequent browser errors over the time range, grouped by message, page, source location and build.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (client_message, page, location, build) (count_over_time({service="calorize-api"} |= "\"message\":\"client.error\"" | json client_message="client_message", page="route", location="location", build="build" [$__range])))

panels.title: Client error log
panels.description: Raw browser error reports, newest first. Expand a line for kind, client_message, location, route, build and user_id.

panels.title: Log volume by level
panels.description: Lines logged per interval by calorize-api. A red band appearing is the fastest way to spot a new failure.

panels.title: Errors & warnings
panels.description: calorize-api ERROR and WARN lines, newest first.

panels.title: Log search
panels.description: All calorize-api logs filtered by the Search box above. Paste a request_id, user_id, trace_id or any text (case-insensitive).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by the API process.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Resident memory (what the host sees) vs. live Go heap.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: A steady climb that never comes back down is a goroutine leak.

panels.title: GC pause (avg)
panels.description: Average stop-the-world GC pause per cycle.
